text.description_html:
Don-Jo 6" x 48" Polished Brass Door Push Plate

Extra wide solid brass push plate. 6" wide x 48" high commercial door push plate. These wide push plates are made of .050" thick, high quality solid brass for longevity. Packaged with brass mounting screws for easy installation.

These commercial push plates are made in the USA by Don-Jo Mfg.

Specifications of Don-Jo 73-605 Polished Brass Push Plate

  • Plate Width: 6"
  • Plate Height: 48"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws

*Sold Individually.
